sourceEmitterBudget.reason: CSharp4 first passed; historical Native2 parse-location mismatches reproduced. One CLI after lexical/format/output-parse and diagnostic-source ownership comparison.

decisions: CSharp first lexes input while collecting redundant parentheses, formats it, then lexes/parses formatted output. Native currently parses input before rewriting and re-analyzes original source to print errors; two parse diagnostic coordinates differ.

Expose lexical-only diagnostics over already lexed tokens using the existing invalid-token classifier. Share that classifier with ordinary analyzePreparedRule; leave raw layout/interpolation and all grammar decisions at final parse, as the CSharp lexer does.

Reuse initial tokens for parenthesis discovery. Parse the resulting output after all layout transforms. Return the exact failing source owner and selected diagnostics rather than re-analyzing another source.

Keep public status/bytes behavior: errors remain status1 with empty public output bytes; append owned diagnosticSource/diagnostics fields for error rendering. CLI stdin/path consume the selected diagnostic against those bytes. LSP and retained formatter probes continue using existing status/bytes fields.
No extra input-parser fallback, diagnostic coordinate rewriting, fixture exceptions, numeric type-ID checks or weakened expected messages.

preflightSourceCorrection.cause: Return each selected diagnostic code inside its conditional branch rather than treating return as an ordinary target after a conditional flow. No parser/semantic gate changed.
